demand_diagnostics.interpretation: Low rate/coverage can retain small targets without a unit cap. Prior and Poisson arrivals are scenarios, not identified hidden demand. Lost requests require feasibility attribution before adding demand.

calibration_summary.rate_method: leave-one-SKU-out group shrinkage, then time-decayed own positive payments/exposure
calibration_summary.availability_limit: Older exposure is physical-stock proxy; reachable telemetry improves future evidence.
calibration_summary.uncertainty: Conditional sales and geometric supply scenarios; not latent-demand identification.

shop.note: Shared-data forecasts, not measured lift. Cash converts to inventory; acquisition alone adds no Book. Stars effect unmodeled; retain validated quality and full refund guards. Select repeat-demand depth by marginal Book/rank, cash and supply delay; raw peer quantities are not targets.

buyer.note: Paid Saved contributions are normalized, not absolute surplus. Pending quality is not success. Post scores are sampled from newest 100 public posts, not causal format lift or the full forum aggregate.

supply_execution_60min.note: POST success counts actual acquisition; prepared plans do not. Legacy refusal events mix quantity, eligibility and reservations.

daily_usage.scope: Shop/Buyer journal only; other applications using this API key are not included
daily_usage.cost_note: Token-priced estimate, not an OpenAI invoice. Raw usage and reservations remain inspectable.
